brief:
Gaza's death toll has risen to 74,640 with 175,947 wounded, Middle East Eye reported, after hospitals across the Strip received ten bodies and 22 injured over the past 48 hours. Medical sources attributed the surge to ongoing casualties in the territory.

The updated figures reflect the cumulative toll since the conflict's escalation, with hospitals continuing to document arrivals of deceased and wounded patients amid the humanitarian crisis.
dek: Gaza death toll rises after medical sources report 10 deaths in last 48 hours Gaza's death toll has surged to 74,640 with another 175,947 wounded after hospitals across the Strip reported that they had received ten bodies and 22 injured in the last 48 hours.
title: Gaza death toll reaches 74,640 after hospitals receive ten bodies
